# The claim responder welcomes a returning contributor as if they were new

Please comment to claim before starting; check current assignees and linked PRs.

## Context

The claim responder answers every claim on a `good first issue` or `help wanted` issue with "Thanks for claiming this, @&lt;login&gt;, and welcome!", whatever the claimant's history. On 2026-11-17 it greeted @02Aditya2323 that way on #21189 ([the reply](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21189#issuecomment-6959888887)), after two of their pull requests had merged (#21242, #21250). The operator asked for "welcome back" for contributors who already have a merged pull request.

## The Problem

A returning contributor is greeted like a stranger. The workflow already knows better: to set the claim limit, it counts the claimant's merged pull requests across the organisation, then keeps only the limit.

## The Architectural Reality

- `.github/workflows/claim-responder.yml:616` to `:633` (the claim path): searches `org:neomjs is:public is:pr is:merged author:<login>`, turns `data.total_count` into a limit with `claimLimit` from `buildScripts/util/contributorStanding.mjs`, and keeps only `claimLimit`. On a failed or incomplete search it warns and keeps the one-claim limit. `readClaimLimit` (`:215`) does the same for the pull-request path.
- `buildScripts/util/claimResponse.mjs`: `decideClaim` passes `claimLimit` on to `renderReply`, whose two greetings say "and welcome!" at `:634` (assigned) and `:643` (first in line).
- `buildScripts/util/contributorStanding.mjs`, `standing(count)`: `rung` is null below one merge, so `standing(count).rung !== null` means exactly "has a merged pull request". Its `returning` rung starts at five merges; that rung sets the claim limit and is not the greeting's threshold.
- Unit specs: `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/claimResponse.spec.mjs` and `contributorStanding.spec.mjs` in the same folder.
- Design authority: the operator's request above (2026-11-17); no guide or JSDoc fixes the greeting's wording (searched `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `claimResponse.mjs`, `contributorStanding.mjs`).

## The Fix

1. In the claim path (`claim-responder.yml:616` to `:633`), keep the merged count the search already returned as `mergedCount` next to `claimLimit`; it stays `undefined` when the search fails.
2. Pass `mergedCount` to `decideClaim`, and from there to `renderReply`, as a new optional option.
3. `renderReply` says "and welcome back!" when `standing(mergedCount).rung` is not null, and "and welcome!" otherwise, including when `mergedCount` is `undefined`. Nothing else in either reply changes.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A claimant with one or more merged pull requests across the organisation gets "welcome back" in both greetings (assigned, first in line).
- [ ] A claimant with none, or whose count could not be read, gets "welcome" as today.
- [ ] `claimResponse.spec.mjs` covers a count of 0, a count of 1 and an unknown count for both greetings.
- [ ] No other reply text changes, and the workflow makes no extra API call.
- [ ] The unit tier passes: `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/`

## Out of Scope

- The other replies: at capacity, held by someone else, withdrawal, overlap and release notices.
- The merge comment of `merge-comment.yml`, which already names the contributor's standing.
- What the claim limit counts, and merging the claim path's count with `readClaimLimit`.

## Avoided Traps

- **Keying the greeting on the `returning` rung (five merges):** a contributor with one merge is already back. `standing(count).rung` is the one-merge test.
- **A second search for the greeting:** the claim path has already fetched the count.
- **`author_association` (`CONTRIBUTOR`):** it counts commits to this repository only, so a contributor whose merges are in another `neomjs` repository would still be welcomed as new.

## Related
